purpose: (Clinical Focus: This value set identifies LOINC codes representing clinical documents related to the transfer of care between healthcare settings or providers.),(Data Element Scope: Codes representing transfer-of-care document types used to support clinical handoffs and continuity of care in electronic health records.),(Inclusion Criteria: LOINC document concepts representing a transfer summary where component = 'transfer summary note' and scale = 'DOC),(Exclusion Criteria: Excludes DOC type codes that do not directly pertain to care transition documentation, such as general progress notes, discharge summaries, or administrative records.)
